configurations.name: Coverage amount dropdown order
configurations.source: User-confirmed Coverage documentation; Library planned setCoverageOrder in src/content/docs/configurations.ts. Runtime supported through global bindings and src/domain/coveragePresentation.ts.

configurations.name: Initial coverage amount selection
configurations.source: User-confirmed Coverage documentation; existing minimum-positive behavior in src/app/useCoverageState.ts. Order and initial selection are separate controls. Runtime supported through src/domain/coveragePresentation.ts.

configurations.name: Specified initial coverage amount
configurations.source: Global template definition; only used when coverage-amount-default-mode is specified. Zero is the unassigned placeholder, not an instruction to select zero coverage. An effective Site may assign a specific value; runtime supported through src/domain/coveragePresentation.ts.

configurations.name: Lock the configured coverage amount
configurations.source: Library planned setCoverageAmount in src/content/docs/configurations.ts sets and locks an amount; amt sets the value and dprods disables the dropdown in the Library URL table. Recorded control; runtime supported through src/domain/coveragePresentation.ts.
